import pandas as pd
path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/8d46b8d6-b38a-47ff-ac74-cda14cf2d19b.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(path)
# Robust subset: remove incomplete or unknown entries
clean = df[df['bill_length_mm'].notna() & df['sex'].isin(['MALE','FEMALE'])]
# Task-driven filter: not on Dream Island and beak length ≤ 42mm
filtered = clean[(clean['island'] != 'Dream') & (clean['bill_length_mm'] <= 42)]
print('Filtered penguin count:', filtered.shape[0])

The task only required excluding penguins living on Dream Island or with beaks longer than 42mm. This task derailment (FM-2.3) led to undercounting the eligible penguins. Further derailment occurred when the team later adopted a non-2012 "harmonized" population estimate (30,000,000) instead of the specified end-of-2012 upper estimate, compounding the deviation from the intended objective. The combination of these derailments produced the incorrect final percentage.
